notes: The workflow plugin carries no specialists of its own -- it ships skills, scripts and two session hooks, so its extensions array is empty by construction rather than unfilled. This repo consumes itself (see CLAUDE.md); through the github source it sees the most recently pushed version, not ongoing branch work. Inventory brought to 19 on 2026-07-29 -- the full roster, matching the enabled plugin exactly. Six were added: 02-09, 03-02, 04-11, 04-12, 04-13, 06-30, whose lenses landed with the adopt-the-six change (PR #212) while this register was not updated alongside. That gap is why an inventory drift can sit unnoticed in the register of the very repo that owns the check: 'exists in the consumer but is not in the register' is an [INFO], and the session hook reports only [ERROR] lines, so nothing surfaced it at session start. It took a deliberate run of check-connectors.ps1 to find. Whoever lands lenses here updates this array in the same change.
